nodes.description: Germline biallelic PIGS variants. In the founding family the p.Trp36* allele lowered PIGS mRNA and protein, and downstream methionines produced truncated isoforms with some residual activity. nodes.description: The GPI transamidase in the endoplasmic reticulum cleaves the C-terminal GPI attachment signal of precursor proteins, forms a carbonyl intermediate with the substrate, and transfers the preassembled GPI to the new C terminus. PIGK carries the catalytic triad; PIGS and PIGT are required for formation of the carbonyl intermediate. Without PIGS the anchor is still synthesized but is not transferred to protein; in Drosophila, loss of PIG-S destabilizes PIG-K.
